mentions.name: Meeting/event sign-up form generator script
mentions.description: This script automates creating Google Forms for meeting and event sign-ups, using a Google Form to generate other Google Forms.
mentions.source_excerpt: Ed: and I just realized you can use a Google form to create a Google form... So I set up a small script to generate meeting/event sign up forms...
